content.short: Ekubo is a high-performance concentrated liquidity protocol and DEX natively built on Starknet.
content.description: Ekubo is a premier decentralized exchange and concentrated liquidity protocol designed specifically for the Starknet ecosystem. By utilizing a sophisticated architecture optimized for Starknet's ZK-rollup infrastructure, Ekubo provides traders with a professional-grade experience featuring extremely low fees and near-instant execution. The platform allows liquidity providers to concentrate their capital within custom price ranges, significantly enhancing capital efficiency and reducing slippage compared to traditional AMMs. With its focus on performance, capital-efficient design, and deep integration with Starknet's native features, Ekubo serves as a foundational building block for decentralized finance innovation within the Starknet Layer 2 landscape.
content.meta: Ekubo is the leading concentrated liquidity DEX on Starknet, offering high-efficiency trading and optimized liquidity management for Web3 users.
